source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES proposes a relevant read but assumes the front-panel URI, disables TLS checking, limits evidence to three fields and omits the explicit IPMI comparison.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires actual front-panel member/device mapping, complete protected parity and no-write handling.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 956/2291 accepts the direct partial command without proving that FP names the installed front-panel FRU.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: FE_1~4 are multiple front-end FRUs and HIB is a separate interconnect board; neither substitutes for the front panel.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves WebUI/IPMI coverage; ED-34 bounds alternative tooling; ED-35 prevents three-field scope reduction; ED-36 treats mapping/reference as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify the installed front-panel FRU is the object represented by FRU_FP and that its complete inventory agrees across the BMC WebUI, exact Redfish member, exact read-only IPMI FRU record and Project reference.
original_method: Bind the physical front panel to its management objects, collect full protected Redfish and IPMI FRU evidence plus the WebUI view, normalize the approved fields and compare them without clearing logs or changing FRU/BMC state.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the front-panel-to-Redfish/IPMI mapping and authoritative field matrix. Collection and comparison are automatable; UI-only details and discrepancies remain for engineer review.
safety_requirements: Preserve SEL and host logs rather than clearing them.
Use read-only FRU retrieval; never edit EEPROM, reset BMC or reboot.
Do not assume `/Chassis/FRU_FP` or a default IPMI FRU device; prove the physical linkage.
Use trusted transport, protected credentials and redacted identifiers.
Retain raw strings/bytes beside normalized encodings.
Stop on duplicate/missing mapping or unresolved source disagreement without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the same front panel across physical, Redfish, IPMI and WebUI identities.
Collect complete timestamped redacted API and IPMI FRU data.
Capture the WebUI detail and normalize the approved field set.
Compare against the Project reference with explicit absent/stale/encoding outcomes.
engineer_actions: Approve fields, normalization, redaction and source authority.
Review discrepancies and assign the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The three-field GET is partial and insecure, assumes target identity and omits the Master-required IPMI and WebUI reconciliation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve FRU_FP from the actual collection and exact IPMI device, then compare complete protected raw-to-normalized data plus WebUI/reference.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_FP, source WebUI and ipmitool comparison, readable/correct Criterion and 2/0-minute estimates remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor front-panel FRU layout and Project manufacturing record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic target mapping, complete fields, secure access and redaction while retaining original comparisons.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Three projected API properties do not cover IPMI, WebUI or complete FRU identity.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Front-panel mapping, layout/reference and authority rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Friendly FP labels can point to another front assembly and cached records may be stale.

project_override_considerations: Alternative FRU tooling is acceptable only with exact front-panel binding, engineer approval, per-field equivalence and uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage recorded.
expected_evidence: Physical front-panel/BMC identity and verified API/IPMI mapping
Complete raw redacted Redfish and read-only IPMI outputs
Encoding-aware per-field comparison including stale/missing states
Preserved logs, no-write proof and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master fields consistently target front-panel FRU correctness and IPMI parity; only the prior automation suggestion is incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Front-panel inventory purpose is clear. Exact mappings and expected data are normal readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores complete IPMI/UI/reference parity and rejects assumed insecure targeting.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with its hybrid classification and exact mapping controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds physical-object proof before the direct GET can be credited.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps FP distinct from FE and HIB records.

review_improvement: Makes the front-panel physical identity a prerequisite and preserves complete raw provenance across all inventory surfaces rather than trusting a convenient URI and three labels.
independent_technical_reasoning: A front-panel assembly can share manufacturer/product data with other chassis FRUs, so a plausible response is not identity proof. Relationship mapping and the exact IPMI device must first bind the physical panel; only then can field parity demonstrate correctness.
